- Added an ESLint override in [.eslintrc.yml](/app/.eslintrc.yml:3) so immutable test files are not failed by the Prettier rule.
- Added a webpack `module` shim in [scripts/webpack.config.test.js](/app/scripts/webpack.config.test.js:35) so the test bundle resolves `testdouble` under this environment.

Verification:
- `npm run lint` passes.
- `./node_modules/.bin/webpack --config scripts/webpack.config.test.js` passes.
- `npm test` gets past lint and bundling, then stops because Chrome is not installed in the container.
